notes: Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) — global integrated producer/distributor of fresh fruit and vegetables. Formed Jul 2021 by combining Total Produce + Dole Food Co; NYSE-listed since IPO Jul 30 2021. Three segments post-2024: Fresh Fruit (bananas, pineapples, primarily tropical), Diversified EMEA, Diversified Americas/ROW. Sold Fresh Vegetables to Chiquita Aug 2024 for $293M (formerly 4th segment, now discontinued). Owns/leases ~109K acres of banana/pineapple farms across LatAm + Africa + Asia. CIK 1858253.

periods.notes: FY20 (pro forma — pre-merger Total Produce + Dole Food): revenue $4.67B. Combined adj EBITDA $290M. Pre-IPO baseline.
FY21: revenue $9.22B (combined Dole + Total Produce). IPO July 2021 with $400M raise. Adj EBITDA $380M.
FY22: revenue $9.42B (+2%). Adj EBITDA $327M. Listeria recall + Yuma freeze impacted Fresh Vegetables. FX headwinds.
FY23: revenue $8.29B. Adj EBITDA $363M (+11%). Reorganized into 3 segments. Dispose of Progressive Produce (Apr 2024).

FY24: revenue $8.47B (continuing ops). Adj EBITDA $382M (+5%). Sold Fresh Vegetables to Chiquita Aug 2024 for $293M (now discontinued ops). Net income $148M ($1.56/sh). 109K owned/leased acres tropical.
